enter_plan_mode.description: Enter planning mode. No tool — text only. Design approach, then exit_plan_mode.

exit_plan_mode.description: Leave planning mode, resume tool access.

enable_tools.description: REQUIRED after search_tools: activate found tool. Without this, found tool UNAVAILABLE. Accept exact name (e.g. "get_weather") or domain prefix (e.g. "domain:Finance"). Ready NEXT turn.

parameters.tools: Tool name or domain prefix to enable.

disable_tools.description: Deactivate tool to free context. Accept name or domain prefix. Core tool can't be disabled.

parameters.tools: Tool name or domain prefix to disable.

discover_and_enable_tools.description: Search ALL tool ({{totalToolCount}}) AND enable match in one step. Found tool ready next turn. Covers: {{domainListLowercase}}.

parameters.query: Search term for tool name/description. e.g. {{sampleKeywords}}.

create_skill.description: Create reusable workflow recipe. Skill = saved instruction with {{variable}} placeholder. Capture multi-step workflow as single action. Persists across session.

parameters.name: Unique skill name. Serves as ID.
parameters.prompt: Instruction to execute. Use {{variable}} for placeholder.

execute_skill.description: Run skill by ID. Instruction populated with variable and executed.

list_skills.description: List skill in this scope: name, skillId, what for. Read skill with load_skill.

load_skill.description: Read skill full instruction by name. System prompt list skill as `name: what for`; task match → call this, follow what come back. Give skill body and bundled resource.

parameters.name: Skill name, same as skill list.

read_skill_file.description: Read one file in skill folder (reference, template, script text) by path inside folder, as load_skill `resources` list. Read script not run it: run script with shell tool, it ask approval like always.

parameters.skill: Skill name, same as skill list.
parameters.path: File path inside skill folder, like references/template.md. No absolute, no '..'.

enter_worktree.description: Enter isolated worktree. Creates branch, redirects tool to separate directory. For risky change or experiment. exit_worktree to merge/discard.

exit_worktree.description: Leave worktree. 'merge' to keep, 'discard' to drop.

parameters.commitMessage: Commit message for merge. Auto-generated if omitted.

write_todo.description: Write/update todo list. Track multi-step work with persistent checklist. Call with full updated list — replaces previous.

summarize_conversation.description: Compress conversation into summary. Use when conversation long. Stored for future turn.

parameters.summary: Compressed summary: key decision, file changed, task status, remaining.

ask_user.description: Ask user question. Default: loop pause until answered — use for clarification or confirmation before major action. blocking=false: show card, keep working, answer come later as <user-answer> message. Never blocking=false when next step need answer. Up to 4 question per call.

parameters.blocking: Optional: default true (wait). false → show card, keep working, answer come later as <user-answer>.

list_mcp_resources.description: List resource from connected MCP server.

parameters.server_name: MCP server name. Omit for all.

read_mcp_resource.description: Read resource from MCP server by URI.

set_timer.description: Set wait timer for in-session pause. For async op, build check, retry. Fires prompt back after duration. 30-599s. For reminder/alarm: use create_cron_job.

list_timers.description: List active timer. For reminder: list_cron_jobs.

cancel_timer.description: Cancel active timer. For cron: delete_cron_job.

search_conversations.description: Search past session using natural language. Semantic match returns title, summary, date, memory count. Use for 'remember when...' or prior context.

parameters.query: Search term. e.g. 'MCP debug', 'WebSocket drop fix'.

create_artifact.description: Make big standalone document (markdown or html). Saved to Artifacts gallery, shown in chat. For big keepable thing: report, guide, story, styled page. NOT for normal chat answer or small snippet. html must be self-contained (inline CSS/JS, no outside network) — runs in sandbox iframe. Returns artifactId for update_artifact later.

parameters.title: Short document title. e.g. 'Q3 Marketing Plan'.
parameters.kind: 'markdown' for prose/report (GFM, math, code). 'html' for styled/interactive page (self-contained, sandboxed).

update_artifact.description: Replace document artifact content with new full version (old version kept). Give artifactId from create_artifact or list_artifacts, plus WHOLE new document — no diff, no fragment. Use when user want revise document made earlier. No make duplicate artifact for revision.

parameters.title: New title, or skip to keep old.

list_artifacts.description: List recent artifacts in project gallery — documents (markdown/html) and captured visual output (image, embed, video, audio). Use to find artifactId when user mean document from earlier chat.

retrieve_offloaded_content.description: Old tool result got stored away, not lost. Stub in chat shows offload_id. Give offload_id plus pattern (regex) or startLine/endLine or headLines. Grab small slice, no re-run tool.

parameters.pattern: Regex to search. Bad regex become plain text match.
parameters.headLines: First N line when no pattern/range. Default: 100.

compact_context.description: Squeeze old chat into summary next step. Call when sub-task DONE (test pass, question answered) and old detail not needed. NOT when mid-work, stuck, debugging, or chat short. Recent turn kept whole. Stored tool result still recoverable with retrieve_offloaded_content.

parameters.reason: One line why now good moment. e.g. 'auth work done, test green'.

checkpoint.description: Carve mark in cave wall at this point of talk, so can walk back later. Carve mark BEFORE risky wander — strange path, big search, bug hunt — where detail not matter after done. Later, rewind throw away all talk after mark from working head: cheaper than squeeze-summary, and lose nothing — thrown words still on wall, user still see. Same name again? Mark move here. Mark sit at last finished turn — this turn land after mark.

parameters.name: Short mark name, like 'before-auth-hunt'. No name? Get checkpoint-<n>.
parameters.description: One line on what wander about to happen, so later rewind know what it throw.

rewind.description: Throw away all talk after mark (no name given? newest mark) from working head. Use when wander done and step-by-step no longer matter — say lasting conclusion in reply FIRST (this turn survive), then rewind. Not delete: thrown words stay on wall, user still see, but they not go into head for next turns, even after reload. Better than compact_context when mark wraps the noise — no summary made, nothing twisted, nothing paid.

parameters.checkpoint: Name of mark to walk back to. No name? Newest mark.

run_async_task.description: Run tool in background. Returns task ID immediately. Tool run behind while you work. Query with list_async_tasks, stop with cancel_async_task. System notify when done.

parameters.toolName: Tool name to run in background.
parameters.toolArguments: Argument for tool, same as normal call.
parameters.continueWorking: Optional: true = keep working this turn; completion come as <task-notification> at next step (or next turn). Default false = end turn now.

list_async_tasks.description: List background task. Show ID, tool, status, result.

run_tool_program.description: Run small JavaScript program that call many READ-ONLY tool, filter result, return only evidence you need. Use instead of many read call whose raw output you no need. Helpers: callTool(name, args), callTools([{name,args}]) parallel. Return value = tool result. Keep small.

parameters.code: JavaScript body. Top-level await and return allowed.
parameters.description: Optional: short label shown to user.

read_untrusted.description: Read untrusted stuff WITHOUT it enter your head. Other reader, no tools, read source and answer question as JSON that fit your schema. You get only { result }. Use for facts from web page, email, message, MCP resource. One source: url, resource {server_name, uri}, tool {name, arguments} (e.g. read_email), or content. Schema objects closed. Bad answer: one retry, then { error, issues }.

parameters.tool: Tool that return stranger content, and its arguments.
parameters.schema: JSON Schema of answer you want. Ask for fields, not text.
parameters.question: What to find in content.

report_progress.description: Tell parent agent short progress while you keep work. Only at real milestone (finding parent can use now, blocker, plan change) — not every step. Not final answer: finish task, end with full summary. Max 10 update per task; parent only get them while it work.

parameters.message: Update, one or two sentence (max 2000 char).

ask_oracle.description: Ask stronger model for second opinion on hard choice: design, bug you no understand, shaky plan. Oracle see ONLY what you write — no conversation, no files, no tools — so put all it need in `context` (code, error, what you tried). Oracle no act, only advise; you decide. Cost more than normal step, count against cost budget: use when wrong answer expensive, not routine.

parameters.question: Question, answerable without this conversation (up to 4000 characters).
parameters.context: All oracle need: code, errors, constraints, what you tried (up to 24000 characters).

wait_for_tasks.description: Block until background work finish, return result in place. Wait on async task (run_async_task) and/or sub-agent (create_subagent). No id = wait all running. Bounded by timeoutSeconds.

parameters.taskIds: Optional: async task id to wait.

set_goal.description: Set persistent goal for conversation: what 'done' mean, in user words. Optional: how to know done, max dollars, max turns, deadline. Shown every turn. Refused for sub-agent.

update_goal.description: Update goal: progress (summary/percent), what block you, or status. Use status 'completed' when criteria met; set blockedOn when stuck, not spin. Only user can pause.

parameters.blockedOn: Current obstacle, or null when clear.

clear_goal.description: Remove persistent goal. Use when user drop objective; to finish goal, prefer update_goal status 'completed'.
